source: V17-PACKET-R1_LABEL_SCALE512, 512 queries and 1485 original sentence actions
input: [QUERY] question [STATE_TITLES] first 8 V8 packet titles [CANDIDATE] original rank10 document title and sentence [DISPLACED] V8 rank9 packet text
label: actual 0.90 success at the refined depth9 context; no Target response or oracle outcome in input
fold_rule: first eight SHA256 bytes of example_id modulo 4; all actions from one query stay together
policy: Among per-query no-extra-context actions use max OOF predicted success. Primary policy switches only the top 5% of all queries by that max score, otherwise STAY.
primary_gate: On query-grouped OOF replay, top-5% policy must have at least three more 0.90 repairs than breaks, no Complete regression, and mean cumulative context no higher than V8. This train-only gate does not open sealed sets.
